title: A smooth compactly supported cut-off in V that equals 1 outside a set of small measure
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, let ν be a finite Borel measure on ℝ^P, let V ⊆ ℝ^P be open with ν(ℝ^P ∖ V) = 0, and let δ > 0. Then there is a C^∞ function χ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support such that tsupport χ ⊆ V, 0 ≤ χ(x) ≤ 1 for every x, and ν({x : χ(x) ≠ 1}) < ofReal δ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid P)), IsFiniteMeasure ν → IsOpen V → ν Vᶜ = 0 → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ χ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) χ ∧ HasCompactSupport χ ∧ tsupport χ ⊆ V ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x ∧ χ x ≤ 1) ∧ ν {x | χ x ≠ 1} < ENNReal.ofReal δ
